text:
sara-peopleops: Hey team — coordinating onboarding for Lina (remote, OR) starting Mon 03/30. We have three open items: I-9 verification (name on offer differs from passport), background check still shows 'identity mismatch', and scheduling day-1 orientation + benefits session. Can folks advise on options? :wave:

mike-it: For laptop/VPN we can ship Monday if we get confirmed shipping address and ID match by Fri EOD. I'll need name that matches the ID used for shipping label. :package:

alex-recruiter: Lina updated her married name after offer. Offer shows 'Lina Hart', passport is 'Lina Perez'. She uploaded a name-change affidavit to the portal earlier today. I noted it in Workday. Can that count?

emily-compliance: Hiring ops — we can't accept affidavit alone for I-9. For remote hires in OR we either: 1) use an authorized agent (local notary/HR rep) to physically inspect documents, or 2) bring them into an approved kiosk/partner. We can also do a designated verifier if someone local volunteers.

sara-peopleops: Right — Lina is fully remote and lives in Portland. She can't come to SF. Any volunteers for designated verifier in Portland area? Otherwise we'll set up a notary-courier.

lisa-newhire: Hi! I'm Lina — I can go to a UPS Notary or a local notary. Morning appointments are easier for me. I uploaded the marriage certificate to the portal just now. Happy to book whatever works. :slightly_smiling_face:

bg-check-bot: Background check for Lina Perez — Status: IDENT_MATCH_ISSUE. Action required: provide government ID + name-history doc. Vendor case #VND-987654. Estimated hold: 48–72 hours after docs received.

emily-compliance: Thanks @lisa-newhire — please attach the marriage certificate and a copy of the passport to the vendor portal (or share to secure HR upload). Once vendor confirms name history it should clear.

eva-office-svcs: If you want a local verifier, I can reach out to our Portland office concierge network (we have 2 verified agents). They can do a same-week verification if Lina can make one morning appointment. There may be a $60 fee.

mike-it: Action items from IT side: 1) confirm shipping name/address, 2) if verification via notary, set shipping 'hold for pickup' at notary address or ship to home after successful ID confirmation. Please ping me once verification path chosen.

alex-recruiter: Lina, would morning Tue 03/31 work for an orientation check-in? We usually do benefits intro at 10am PT and product onboarding at 2pm PT. If not, we can swap.

lisa-newhire: Tue 03/31 mornings work great. I'll aim for the 10am benefits intro. If vendor needs docs first, I can send today.

sara-peopleops: Plan proposal: Lina will book a UPS notary slot for Friday morning, upload marriage cert + passport to secure HR portal now, vendor will re-run BG check, vendor updates in 48–72h. @mike-it will ship laptop Friday with 'signature required' to ensure correct handoff. @eva-office-svcs if concierge option is faster we'll switch and cover the fee. Everyone ok? :+1:

emily-compliance: That plan is compliant. Add to checklist: 1) confirm notary receipt (screenshot), 2) vendor confirmation email, 3) attach verification record in Workday.

mike-it: Will prep laptop and label but hold until I see 'verified' from compliance. ETA shipping Fri afternoon if cleared.

sara-peopleops: I'll update the onboarding checklist and send Lina the calendar invites for orientation + benefits once hotel/verification done. Quick checklist (copy/paste):

```
- Lina: upload passport + marriage certificate to HR portal (DONE/UPLOAD_LINK)
- Vendor: re-run BG check and clear identity mismatch (Vendor case VND-987654)
- Notary: appointment booked Fri 03/27 9:30am (if UPS chosen)
- IT: prepare laptop, hold for shipping confirmation
- HR: schedule 10am benefits intro + 2pm product intro on Tue 03/31
- Compliance: post verification record in Workday
```

alex-recruiter: I'll hold the 10am slot tentative and convert to confirmed after compliance OK.

lisa-newhire: Uploaded docs and booked UPS slot for Fri 03/27 9:15am. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

bg-check-bot: Vendor update: documents received for case VND-987654. Re-run queued.

emily-compliance: Once vendor confirms, @mike-it please mark 'release for shipping' in the IT tracker. Sara — can you drop the orientation invites when confirmed?

sara-peopleops: Yup — will send invites and onboarding Slack DM thread to Lina after vendor clears. Thanks all! :tada:
